# maple_status_page (Resource)

A public status page: its settings, theme, components, visibility, password and custom domain. Incidents are operational and not managed here. Needs an API key with the `status_pages:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maple_status_page" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme Status"
  slug        = "acme-status"
  description = "Live status of Acme's API and dashboard."
  website_url = "https://acme.example"
  support_url = "https://acme.example/support"
  logo_url    = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/logo.png")}"

  auto_incidents = "draft"
  theme = {
    preset     = "midnight"
    appearance = "dark"
    accent     = "#a5b4fc"
  }

  components = [
    { name = "API", monitor_id = maple_uptime_monitor.api.id },
    { name = "Dashboard", group = "Websites" },
    { name = "Docs", group = "Websites", show_uptime = false },
  ]

  custom_domain = "status.acme.example"
}

# The DNS records the custom domain needs, here at Cloudflare. They are known once
# the domain is set and stay known while it is unchanged; when you add or change
# custom_domain, apply the page with -target first.
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "status" {
  for_each = { for r in maple_status_page.acme.custom_domain_dns_records : "${r.type}:${r.name}" => r }

  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  type    = each.value.type
  name    = each.value.name
  content = each.value.value
  ttl     = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shown as the page title.
- `slug` (String) The page's address, `<slug>.<status domain>`: 3 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or inner hyphens. Unique across Maple.

### Optional

- `auto_incidents` (String) Whether a linked monitor going down opens a page incident: `off` (default), `draft` (unpublished until you publish it) or `publish`.
- `components` (Attributes List) Every component, in display order (at most 200). Components are matched to the page's existing ones by name, so their IDs, incidents and uptime history survive edits; a renamed one is recreated, and one left out is deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `custom_domain` (String) Also serve the page on this hostname, e.g. `status.acme.com`. Add the records in `custom_domain_dns_records` at your DNS provider. Removing it removes the domain.
- `description` (String) Text under the title.
- `favicon_url` (String) The browser tab icon. An https URL, or an uploaded image as a base64 `data:image/...` URL of at most 128 KB, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`.
- `logo_dark_url` (String) A logo shown in dark mode instead of `logo_url`. An https URL, or an uploaded image as a base64 `data:image/...` URL of at most 128 KB, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`.
- `logo_url` (String) The logo. An https URL, or an uploaded image as a base64 `data:image/...` URL of at most 128 KB, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password visitors of a `password` page enter, 8 to 128 characters. Stored by Maple only as a hash, so Terraform cannot see it change outside Terraform. Removing it removes the password.
- `privacy_url` (String) An https link to your privacy policy, shown in the footer.
- `show_powered_by` (Boolean) Whether the page credits Maple. Defaults to `true`.
- `support_url` (String) An https link to your support page, shown in the header.
- `terms_url` (String) An https link to your terms of service, shown in the footer.
- `theme` (Attributes) How the page looks. Unset fields take the default theme's value. Text must reach a WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--theme))
- `visibility` (String) Who can read the page: `public`, `password` (needs `password`) or `internal` (only your organization's members, in Maple; incompatible with `custom_domain`). Unset keeps the page's visibility, `public` for a new page.
- `website_url` (String) Your site, linked from the page.

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain_cname_target` (String) The hostname to CNAME `custom_domain` to.
- `custom_domain_dns_records` (Attributes List) The DNS records `custom_domain` needs: the `routing` CNAME, and `ownership` and `certificate` TXT records while the domain is verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_domain_dns_records))
- `id` (String) The `stp_…` public ID.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Required:

- `name` (String) Component name.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Shown with the component.
- `group` (String) Heading the component is listed under.
- `manual_status` (String) A manual status override: `operational`, `maintenance`, `degraded`, `partial_outage` or `major_outage`. Unset leaves the override as responders set it in Maple, so an apply during an incident does not undo it.
- `monitor_id` (String) The uptime monitor driving its status and uptime bars, typically `maple_uptime_monitor.<name>.id`.
- `show_uptime` (Boolean) Whether the page shows its 90 days of uptime bars. Defaults to `true`.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The `stc_…` component ID, for incidents posted through the API.


<a id="nestedatt--theme"></a>
### Nested Schema for `theme`

Optional:

- `accent` (String) Link and highlight colour as lowercase `#rrggbb`, in every appearance. Unset uses the preset's.
- `appearance` (String) `auto` (default) follows the visitor's setting; `light` or `dark` forces one and enables the colour overrides.
- `background` (String) Page background as lowercase `#rrggbb`. Unset uses the preset's. Applies only when `appearance` is `light` or `dark`.
- `border` (String) Border colour as lowercase `#rrggbb`. Unset uses the preset's. Applies only when `appearance` is `light` or `dark`.
- `card` (String) Card and group header background as lowercase `#rrggbb`. Unset uses the preset's. Applies only when `appearance` is `light` or `dark`.
- `font` (String) Font family: `sans` (default), `serif` or `mono`.
- `preset` (String) Base palette: `default`, `maple`, `mono`, `midnight` or `paper`.
- `radius` (String) Corner radius: `none`, `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`.
- `text` (String) Text colour as lowercase `#rrggbb`. Unset uses the preset's. Applies only when `appearance` is `light` or `dark`.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_domain_dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_domain_dns_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The record name.
- `purpose` (String) `routing`, `ownership` or `certificate`.
- `type` (String) `CNAME` or `TXT`.
- `value` (String) The record value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_status_page.example <id>
```
